name: Autobuildersai
description: Select objects in the editor, type a prompt, and an AI decorates them. The AI keeps a separate memory for every level.

provider.name: AI provider
provider.description: deepseek = DeepSeek (very cheap). gemini = Google Gemini (free tier). claude = Anthropic (paid).

gemini-key.name: Gemini API key
gemini-key.description: Free key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

api-key.name: Anthropic API key
api-key.description: Your Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...). Stored only on this device.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model id sent to the API.

memory-turns.name: Memory size (turns)
memory-turns.description: How many past prompts the AI remembers for each level.
